items.title: Rayman's best, most beautiful adventure is being remade in 3D, for some reason, and it'll be bundled with the leaked Rayman Origins remaster
items.description:

And despite it being over a decade old at this point, the celebrated 2D platformer - with its sumptuous hand-drawn art and wildly imaginative action - still looks and sounds and plays phenomenally today. So it feels a bit odd that, of all the Rayman games Ubisoft could have revisited and remade as the character celebrates his 30th anniversary, it's this one. items.description:
So the rumours were true: CD Projekt Red did originally plan to release Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past this year, but it changed its plan to 2027 to achieve "the best possible result".

items.title: CD Projekt Red reveals huge The Witcher 3 sales milestone, which helps explain why a third expansion is in development 11 years later
items.description:
Why is CD Projekt Red making a third expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, more than a decade after the original game was released? A newly revealed sales milestone of 65 million units probably has something to do with it. That's a hell of an installed base to sell to.

items.title: Unlike The Sims, early access hit Paralives will "never" have paid DLC and will stick to free updates, devs say
items.description:
Though we'd known about it for quite some time, breezy life simulator Paralives has managed to become one of this month's surprise hits. With over 250k copies sold in less than eight hours, it was off to a great start on Steam earlier this week, and now the developers are promising no paid DLC will be released.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 finally revealed, and it's officially leaving last-generation consoles behind
items.description:
Activision and Infinity Ward have revealed Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. It's launching on Xbox Series X/S, PS5, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2 on the 23rd October, 2026.

Read more

items.title: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era reveals early access roadmap as publisher Hooded Horse celebrates 1m copies sold during its first month
items.description:
Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era, the latest entry in the iconic turn-based fantasy strategy series, has convinced most players so far, but it's got a long early access journey ahead. Today, publisher Hooded Horse and developer Unfrozen Studio have shared an extensive roadmap.

Read more

items.title: IOI is 'keeping the British end up' in 007 First Light by switching out Americanisms to "reinforce the immersion"
items.description:
Following earlier gameplay teaser trailers, developer IO Interactive has made some changes to the dialogue in 007 First Light.

items.title: That sword Geralt unsheaths in The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past expansion artwork? We've seen it before
items.description:
UPDATE 1st June: There's been some good, additional sleuthing into the identity of the sword Geralt is holding in The Songs of the Past artwork, related to what's discussed below. And as we now know from a CD Projekt Red livestream, "it is a very important sword for the story", so its identity likely provides a vital clue about the adventure we're going on.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past

items.title: Planet Zoo 2 finally revealed after much teasing, with an autumn release date, aquatic and flying species, and the ability to conserve outside of your zoo
items.description:
Earlier this week, the park sim veterans at Frontier Developments began teasing Planet Zoo 2. Now, the sequel has been fully revealed, and it's coming later this year with a handful of huge additions.

Read more

items.title: Subnautica 2 publisher Krafton now forced to pay $250m earnout to Unknown Worlds developers after more than 4m units sold
items.description:
Subnautica 2 has been off to a stellar start despite some discussions over fighting alien fish, with 2m copies sold within 12 hours of launching on Steam and Xbox's storefronts. Since its 14th May launch, its success has only become bigger, and now Krafton will be forced to pay developer Unknown Worlds $250m.

Read more

items.title: Donkey Kong 64 finally arrives on Nintendo Switch Online next month
items.description:
90s classic Donkey Kong 64 is finally coming to Nintendo Switch Online. It will be available for all those Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack subscribers from next month, on 4th June.

Read more

items.title: A Pragmata sequel? Well, "of course" Capcom's game director would love one, but alas, he is "not the only one who decides"
items.description:
Pragmata's director would "of course" love to make a sequel to Capcom's space-based small girl and astronaut starring game, but he isn't the only person who needs to give it the green light.

Read more

items.title: Fortnite's return to the Apple App Store and iOS has caused an eight-year record surge in downloads, with a spike in daily activity, too
items.description:
Fortnite has faced tons of difficulties in recent times, with engagement going down and massive layoffs at Epic affecting its short-term creative potential. However, its recent return to the Apple App Store has kickstarted a surge in downloads and activity.

Read more

items.title: Bungie details Marathon Season 2 and the new Sentinel class, with a free-to-play week and special sale planned, too
items.description:
Right after dropping the untimely news Destiny 2 won't be getting more support after June, Bungie is ramping up work on Marathon, with Season 2 introducing a spooky new map and mysterious new threats next week.

Read more

items.title: Valve announces significant Steam Deck price rise of almost £200 in the UK, over 40% around the world
items.description:
Valve has announced a substantial price increase for its Steam Deck OLED models, citing "rising memory and storage costs" as the reason.

Read more

items.title: Alan Wake and Control "should have sold more", says Remedy's newly-appointed CEO, who promises he's not the evil exec people expected
items.description:
While both games were critically acclaimed, Remedy's newly-appointed CEO believes Alan Wake and Control "should have sold more" and been more commercially successful than they were. That being said, he has a remedy for Remedy's titles (thank you Matt, for pointing out this the perfect word play here), and believes film and TV adaptations will give the games a boost.

Read more
